powers.name: Radiance
powers.description: Aura. Soft light pulses out from you every few seconds, restoring a small amount of life to every ally within its radius, yourself included.
powers.potencyNote: healing to each ally every 2 seconds

powers.name: Mend
powers.description: A small heal for a small mana cost. Always available; the one you cast most.
powers.potencyNote: healing

powers.name: Divine Light
powers.description: A huge heal for a huge mana cost. The same healing per mana as Mend, delivered all at once. Always available, if you can afford it.
powers.potencyNote: healing

powers.name: Patient Prayer
powers.description: A medium heal that costs far less mana than it should. The catch is a short cooldown, about 6 seconds, so it cannot be your only heal.
powers.potencyNote: healing

powers.name: Lay on Hands
powers.description: The emergency button. Restores most of one ally's life and strips every harmful effect from them, for very little mana. Cooldown of about a minute.
powers.potencyNote: % of the ally's maximum life restored

powers.name: Purify
powers.description: Removes one harmful effect from an ally and restores a sliver of life. Cheap and always available.
powers.potencyNote: healing; also removes harmful effects

powers.name: Absolution
powers.description: Removes every harmful effect from one ally and from everyone standing close to them. No healing. Cooldown of about 12 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: removes every harmful effect from each target

powers.name: Chorus of Light
powers.description: Heals one ally, then leaps to the nearest wounded ally, and again, healing a little less with each leap. More leaps as it levels. Cooldown of about 10 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: healing to the first target, less with each leap

powers.name: Second Dawn
powers.description: Brings one fallen ally back to life with part of their health. Cooldown of about a minute. (The game's Resurrect already does the reviving.)
powers.potencyNote: % of life the ally returns with

powers.name: Guardian Angel
powers.description: Cast before the danger, not after. An angel watches one ally for as long as it takes: the next time they would die, they rise again at once with part of their health, and the watch ends. Cooldown of about a minute before you can set another.
powers.potencyNote: % of life the ally rises with

powers.name: Miracle
powers.description: Ultimate. Wherever they are, every fallen ally returns to life, every ally is healed for a modest amount, and every harmful effect on the party is washed away. Cooldown of about 4 minutes.
powers.potencyNote: % of life the fallen return with; everyone else is healed for 15

powers.name: Ward of Purity
powers.description: Removes one harmful effect from an ally, and for about 20 seconds no new harmful effect can take hold on them. Cooldown of about a minute.
powers.potencyNote: seconds of immunity to new harmful effects

powers.name: Vigil
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. Their life comes back faster on its own.
powers.potencyNote: % faster life regeneration, lasting

powers.name: Benediction
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. Their maximum life is raised.
powers.potencyNote: % maximum life, lasting

powers.name: Smite
powers.description: A weapon strike wreathed in light. The hit deals extra holy damage. Cheap and always available.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit

powers.name: Judgment
powers.description: A heavy, deliberate weapon strike for a large amount of holy damage, and more still against undead and demons. Cooldown of about 10 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit

powers.name: Atonement
powers.description: A weapon strike that turns harm into mercy: part of the damage it deals is given as healing to the most wounded ally nearby. Hits softer than Smite.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit; heals 11

powers.name: Holy Bolt
powers.description: Hurls a bolt of holy light at one enemy. Cheap and always available. (Reuses the game's Holy Bolt, which in this mod harms every kind of monster.)
powers.potencyNote: damage

powers.name: Searing Light
powers.description: Light erupts on one enemy, burning it and every enemy standing close to it. Costs more than Holy Bolt and hits each target a little less.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target

powers.name: Dawnburst
powers.description: Calls down a wide burst of dawn light on a spot. Every enemy in it is burned and every ally in it is healed, each for a modest amount. Cooldown of about 30 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target; heals 11

powers.name: Wellspring
powers.description: Aura. Every ally within its radius, yourself included, regenerates mana faster for as long as they stay near you.
powers.potencyNote: % faster mana regeneration, lasting, for allies in the aura

powers.name: Frostbolt
powers.description: Hurls a bolt of ice at one enemy. Cheap and always available. (Already in the mod as a test spell.)
powers.potencyNote: damage

powers.name: Glacial Spike
powers.description: Drives a great spike of ice into one enemy for heavy damage. Much more damage per mana than Frostbolt, on a cooldown of about 8 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: damage

powers.name: Ice Burst
powers.description: Ice erupts at a spot you choose, striking every enemy in a small area. Always available.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target

powers.name: Hailstorm
powers.description: Hail hammers a wide area you choose. Each enemy takes less than Ice Burst would deal, but far more of them are caught in it. Cooldown of about 12 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target

powers.name: Tidal Wave
powers.description: A wall of water rolls out from you in the direction you face, widening as it goes and striking everything it passes over. Cooldown of about 10 seconds. (The game's Flame Wave, recoloured, already moves this way.)
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target

powers.name: Icebreaker
powers.description: Water's one weapon attack. A strike sheathed in frost; the whole hit lands as ice damage, plus a little more.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit

powers.name: Riptide
powers.description: A surge of water bursts at a spot you choose. Enemies in the small area are battered and allies in it are healed, each for a modest amount. Cooldown of about 6 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target; heals 8

powers.name: Soothing Waters
powers.description: The plain heal. Restores a moderate amount of life to one ally. Always available.
powers.potencyNote: healing

powers.name: Healing Rain
powers.description: A sudden downpour over a wide area you choose. Every ally in it is healed for a small amount. Costly for what each ally receives, but it reaches the whole party at once.
powers.potencyNote: healing to each target

powers.name: Springwater
powers.description: Heals one ally well, and everyone standing close to them for half as much. Cooldown of about 8 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: healing to each target

powers.name: Wash Away
powers.description: Rinses one harmful effect off an ally and restores a sliver of life. Cheap and always available.
powers.potencyNote: healing; also removes harmful effects

powers.name: Purging Rain
powers.description: Rain falls over a wide area you choose and removes one harmful effect from every ally in it. No healing. Cooldown of about 12 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: harmful effect removed from each target

powers.name: Monsoon
powers.description: The big one for a party in trouble. A wide area you choose is drenched: every ally in it is healed for a large amount and every harmful effect on them is washed off. Cooldown of about a minute.
powers.potencyNote: healing to each target; also removes harmful effects

powers.name: Clarity
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. Their mana comes back faster. Stronger than the aura's boost, and it goes with them wherever they walk.
powers.potencyNote: % faster mana regeneration, lasting

powers.name: High Tide
powers.description: For about 20 seconds every ally in the game, wherever they are, regenerates mana faster. A smaller boost than Clarity, given to everyone. Cooldown of about a minute.
powers.potencyNote: % faster mana regeneration for 20 seconds, for every ally

powers.name: Reservoir
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. Their maximum mana is raised.
powers.potencyNote: % maximum mana, lasting

powers.name: Mana Tide
powers.description: Pours your own mana into an ally: you spend a chunk of mana and they receive most of it at once. Cooldown of about 10 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: mana given to the ally (you spend 20)

powers.name: Deep Freeze
powers.description: Encases one enemy and those close to it in ice. For about 6 seconds they cannot move or act. No damage. Cooldown of about 45 seconds. (The game's Stone Curse already holds a monster still this way.)
powers.potencyNote: seconds held

powers.name: Great Flood
powers.description: Ultimate. A flood crashes over a very wide area you choose. Every enemy in it takes heavy damage; every ally in it is healed for a large amount and washed clean of harmful effects. Cooldown of about 3 minutes.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target; heals 29; also removes harmful effects

powers.name: Fire Aura
powers.description: Aura. In the game today. Every 2 seconds a burst of flame burns every monster within its radius. The radius grows as it levels. It also makes you the obvious target: monsters notice you first and prefer you over your allies. It does nothing for allies; it is yours alone.
powers.potencyNote: fire damage every 2 seconds (as built in the game); also threat: monsters treat you as half as far away

powers.name: Firebolt
powers.description: In the game today. A bolt of fire at one enemy. Cheap and always available.
powers.potencyNote: damage

powers.name: Fireball
powers.description: In the game today. A ball of fire that explodes on its target and burns everything beside it.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target

powers.name: Flame Wave
powers.description: In the game today. A wide wall of flame that rolls away from you in the direction you face.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target

powers.name: Inferno
powers.description: In the game today. A short jet of flame straight ahead. Very strong, but it only reaches a few steps.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target

powers.name: Fire Wall
powers.description: In the game today. A long line of fire on the ground that burns anything standing in it for as long as it lasts.
powers.potencyNote: damage in total over 8 seconds to each target

powers.name: Flame Strike
powers.description: In the game today. A weapon strike whose whole hit lands as fire damage, plus a little more. Cheap and always available.
powers.potencyNote: bonus fire damage on the hit (as built in the game)

powers.name: Inferno Strike
powers.description: In the game today. A weapon strike for three times the damage, all of it fire. Cooldown of 12 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: % extra weapon damage, so three times the hit (as built in the game)

powers.name: Flaming Weapon
powers.description: In the game today. A lasting boon on yourself: every weapon hit you land also deals fire damage.
powers.potencyNote: fire damage added to each weapon hit (as built in the game)

powers.name: Ignite
powers.description: A weapon strike that sets the enemy alight. A light hit now, and it adds to the Burn on that enemy. Every strike adds more.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit, plus 5 Burn in total over 20 seconds

powers.name: Flame Cleave
powers.description: New. A sweeping weapon strike trailing fire. It hits your target and every enemy standing beside it. Cooldown of about 8 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit to each target

powers.name: Melt Armor
powers.description: A white-hot weapon strike. From then on that enemy takes more damage from everything, until it dies. Cooldown of about a minute before you can mark another.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit; also 15 % more damage taken by the enemy

powers.name: Stoke the Flames
powers.description: New. For about 20 seconds everything you do deals more damage. Cooldown of about a minute.
powers.potencyNote: % more damage dealt for 20 seconds

powers.name: Phoenix
powers.description: New. Ultimate. When you would die, you burn to ash and rise again at once with part of your life. It then cannot happen again for about 15 minutes.
powers.potencyNote: % of life you rise with

powers.name: Smolder
powers.description: Sets one enemy smouldering from a distance. No hit up front; it adds to the Burn on that enemy, which ticks every 2 seconds for 20 seconds. Every new Burn, from any power, restarts the 20 seconds for all of it.
powers.potencyNote: Burn in total over 20 seconds (1 each tick)

powers.name: Wildfire
powers.description: Fire that spreads. Adds to the Burn on one enemy and on every enemy within its radius. Cooldown of about 10 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: Burn in total over 20 seconds, to each target (1 each tick)

powers.name: Meteor
powers.description: A burning rock falls on one enemy. It and every enemy within the radius take the same heavy fire damage, at once. Cooldown of about 45 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target

powers.name: Kindling
powers.description: Strips the Elemental resistance and immunity from one enemy and those close to it. Until they die, fire, ice, lightning and earth all hit them in full, from you and from your allies. No damage. The Elemental twin of Soul Rend. Cooldown of about a minute.
powers.potencyNote: removes Elemental resistance and immunity

powers.name: Searing Brand
powers.description: A weapon strike that leaves a glowing brand. From then on every hit on that enemy, from anyone, deals a little extra fire damage, until it dies. Cooldown of about 12 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit; from then on every hit on that enemy deals 2 extra fire damage

powers.name: Fan the Flames
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. They attack and cast a little faster.
powers.potencyNote: % faster attacks and casting, lasting

powers.name: Elemental
powers.description: In the game today. A living flame that hunts down an enemy by itself, turning corners to reach it, then explodes like a Fireball. Not assigned to an essence yet.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target

powers.name: Guardian
powers.description: In the game today. Plants a three-headed serpent at a spot. For as long as it lasts it spits Firebolts at any enemy it can see. Not assigned to an essence yet.
powers.potencyNote: damage in total over 8 seconds

powers.name: Immolation
powers.description: In the game today (Hellfire). Fireballs burst out from you in every direction at once. Not assigned to an essence yet.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target

powers.name: Ring of Fire
powers.description: In the game today (Hellfire). A ring of fire springs up around you and burns anything that crosses it for as long as it lasts. Not assigned to an essence yet.
powers.potencyNote: damage in total over 8 seconds to each target

powers.name: Rune of Fire
powers.description: In the game today (Hellfire). A trap laid on the ground. It waits, then explodes in fire when an enemy steps near. Not assigned to an essence yet.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target

powers.name: Rune of Immolation
powers.description: In the game today (Hellfire). A trap laid on the ground. When an enemy steps near, fireballs burst from it in every direction. Not assigned to an essence yet.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target

powers.name: Ironbark
powers.description: Aura. Every ally within its radius, yourself included, gains a slight boost to all three resistances for as long as they stay near you.
powers.potencyNote: % to all three resistances, lasting, for allies in the aura

powers.name: Healing Touch
powers.description: The plain direct heal. Restores a moderate amount of life to one ally at once. Always available.
powers.potencyNote: healing

powers.name: Nourish
powers.description: A direct heal that costs very little. It heals noticeably more if the ally already has one of your heals over time on them. Cooldown of about 6 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: healing
powers.shortText: Cheap heal; more with a HoT

powers.name: Full Bloom
powers.description: The emergency heal. One ally regains most of their life at once, for a modest cost. Cooldown of about a minute.
powers.potencyNote: % of the ally's maximum life restored

powers.name: Pollinate
powers.description: Heals one ally, then drifts on to the nearest wounded ally, and again, healing a little less each time. More leaps as it levels. Cooldown of about 10 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: healing to the first target, less with each leap

powers.name: Verdant Tide
powers.description: Every ally in the game, wherever they are, is healed at once. Less per person than a targeted heal, but nobody is out of reach. Cooldown of about 45 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: healing to each ally

powers.name: Fairy Ring
powers.description: A ring of mushrooms bursts up at a spot you choose and heals every ally standing in the small circle at once. Very cheap for what it gives, if the party is bunched up.
powers.potencyNote: healing to each target

powers.name: Rejuvenation
powers.description: The plain heal over time. One ally steadily regains life for about 12 seconds. Cheap and always available.
powers.potencyNote: healing in total over 12 seconds

powers.name: Spring Shower
powers.description: Every ally in the game, wherever they are, regains a little life over about 10 seconds. Weak for any one person, but cheap for how many it reaches. Cooldown of about 12 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: healing in total over 10 seconds to each ally

powers.name: Sacred Grove
powers.description: A wide grove grows at a spot you choose and lasts about 20 seconds. Allies inside regain life the whole time, and every few seconds it lifts one harmful effect from each of them. Cooldown of about a minute.
powers.potencyNote: healing in total over 20 seconds to each target; also removes harmful effects

powers.name: Remedy
powers.description: Removes one harmful effect from an ally and restores a sliver of life. Cheap and always available.
powers.potencyNote: healing; also removes harmful effects

powers.name: Renewal
powers.description: For about 10 seconds one ally sheds a harmful effect every 2 seconds. No healing. The answer to an ally buried in curses. Cooldown of about 12 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: harmful effects removed in all, one every 2 seconds

powers.name: Fresh Breeze
powers.description: A clean wind reaches every ally in the game and removes one harmful effect from each. Cooldown of about 45 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: harmful effect removed from each ally

powers.name: New Growth
powers.description: Brings one fallen ally back to life with only a little health, then regrows the rest of it over about 15 seconds. Cooldown of about a minute.
powers.potencyNote: % of life on return; regrows a further 60% over 15 seconds

powers.name: Barkskin
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. Their skin hardens like bark: all three resistances are raised. Stronger than the aura's boost, and it goes with them wherever they walk.
powers.potencyNote: % to all three resistances, lasting

powers.name: Canopy
powers.description: Every ally in the game gains a moderate boost to all three resistances for about 20 seconds. Smaller than Barkskin, given to everyone. Cooldown of about a minute.
powers.potencyNote: % to all three resistances for 20 seconds, for every ally

powers.name: Ironwood
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. Their armor is raised.
powers.potencyNote: armor, lasting

powers.name: Oakheart
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. Sturdy as an oak: their maximum life is raised.
powers.potencyNote: % maximum life, lasting

powers.name: Camouflage
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself, with two gifts. You blend into leaf and shadow: monsters notice you later and prefer your allies. And striking from cover, you hit more often: 5% more, and 1% more with each level of the power. The stealth never grows; the accuracy does.
powers.potencyNote: % apparent distance: monsters treat you as half again as far away; also 5 % more chance to hit, +1 for each level

powers.name: World Tree
powers.description: Ultimate. A great tree rises at a spot you choose and stands for about 30 seconds. Allies in its shade regain life rapidly and shed harmful effects, and any fallen ally lying beneath it is raised once. Cooldown of about 4 minutes.
powers.potencyNote: healing in total over 30 seconds, to each ally in its shade

powers.name: Aegis
powers.description: Aura. Every 10 seconds, every ally within its radius, yourself included, receives a very small shield of temporary health. Shields are lost first when damage comes in.
powers.potencyNote: shield on each ally every 10 seconds

powers.name: Shield Bash
powers.description: Requires a shield. Strike an enemy with your shield for modest damage. Cheap and always available.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit

powers.name: Shield Slam
powers.description: Requires a shield. A full-weight slam for heavy damage; the better your armor, the harder it hits. Cooldown of about 8 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit

powers.name: Shield Sweep
powers.description: Requires a shield. Swing the shield in a wide arc, hitting your target and every enemy standing beside it. Cooldown of about 8 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit to each target

powers.name: Concussive Blow
powers.description: Requires a shield. Crack an enemy across the head with the shield's rim. Light damage, and it is left reeling, unable to act, for about 3 seconds. Cooldown of about 12 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit; held for 3 seconds

powers.name: Guarded Strike
powers.description: Requires a shield. Bash an enemy and bring the shield straight back to guard: your armor is raised for about 5 seconds. Cooldown of about 10 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit; also 15 armor

powers.name: Bulwark Slam
powers.description: Requires a shield. Slam into an enemy hard enough to hit everything around it. You gain a shield of temporary health for each enemy struck, lasting about 15 seconds. Cooldown of about 45 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit to each target; 18 shield for each enemy struck

powers.name: Barrier
powers.description: The plain shield. Wraps one ally in a modest shield of temporary health that lasts about 15 seconds or until it is used up. Always available.
powers.potencyNote: shield of temporary health

powers.name: Reinforce
powers.description: A large shield of temporary health on one ally, and their armor is raised for as long as any of that shield remains, up to about 20 seconds. Cooldown of about a minute.
powers.potencyNote: shield of temporary health; also 15 armor

powers.name: Shield Wall
powers.description: One ally and everyone standing close to them each receive a solid shield of temporary health for about 15 seconds. Cooldown of about 45 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: shield of temporary health to each target

powers.name: Phalanx
powers.description: Every ally in the game, wherever they are, receives a small shield of temporary health for about 15 seconds. Cooldown of about a minute.
powers.potencyNote: shield of temporary health to each ally

powers.name: Bulwark
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. Your armor is raised. It stays until you die or leave the game.
powers.potencyNote: armor, lasting

powers.name: Spell Ward
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. All three of their resistances are raised. Cast it once on each person you want protected.
powers.potencyNote: % to all three resistances, lasting

powers.name: Hold the Line
powers.description: A lasting boon on the whole party. Every ally in the game has slightly raised armor for as long as you are with them.
powers.potencyNote: armor, lasting, for every ally

powers.name: Stout Heart
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. Their maximum life is raised.
powers.potencyNote: % maximum life, lasting

powers.name: Resilience
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. Your life comes back faster on its own.
powers.potencyNote: % faster life regeneration, lasting

powers.name: Oathbound
powers.description: A lasting bond with one ally. Part of the damage they would take is dealt to you instead. You can be bound to only one ally at a time; casting it on someone else moves the bond.
powers.potencyNote: % of the ally's damage that is dealt to you instead

powers.name: Stalwart
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself, with two gifts. You make yourself the obvious target: monsters notice you first and prefer you over your allies. And you block more often: 5% more, and 1% more with each level of the power. The threat never grows; the blocking does.
powers.potencyNote: % apparent distance: monsters treat you as half as far away; also 5 % more chance to block, +1 for each level

powers.name: Brace
powers.description: The one big cooldown boon, and it is yours alone. Set your feet behind the shield: a very large boost to your armor and resistances for about 20 seconds. Cooldown of about a minute.
powers.potencyNote: armor, and 30 % to all three resistances for 20 seconds

powers.name: Unbreakable
powers.description: Ultimate. For about 12 seconds every ally in the game takes half damage from everything. Cooldown of about 3 minutes.
powers.potencyNote: % less damage taken by every ally

powers.name: Pall of Shadow
powers.description: Aura. A curse hangs on every enemy within its radius of you: their Astral resistance is lowered for as long as they stay near you, so shadow, holy and other astral damage bites deeper. It does no damage itself.
powers.potencyNote: % less Astral resistance for every enemy in the aura

powers.name: Corruption
powers.description: The plain damage over time. No hit up front; it adds to the Corruption on one enemy, which ticks every 2 seconds for 20 seconds. Every new Corruption, from any power, restarts the 20 seconds for all of it. (Already in the mod as a test spell.)
powers.potencyNote: Corruption in total over 20 seconds (as built in the game)

powers.name: Creeping Rot
powers.description: A thin thread of Corruption on one enemy for very little mana. Each cast adds less than Corruption does, but far more per point of mana. The one to keep piling on through a long fight.
powers.potencyNote: Corruption in total over 20 seconds

powers.name: Shadow Bolt
powers.description: Hurls a bolt of shadow at one enemy. Like any bolt it can miss. About half its damage lands on the hit and the rest is left behind as Corruption. Cheap and always available.
powers.potencyNote: damage at once, then 4 Corruption over 20 seconds

powers.name: Blight
powers.description: Corruption that takes hold of one enemy and everything standing close to it. Each gets less than a single-target cast would give, for more mana. Always available.
powers.potencyNote: Corruption in total over 20 seconds to each target

powers.name: Plague Wind
powers.description: A foul wind blows out from you in the direction you face, widening as it goes. Everything it passes over is left with Corruption. No hit up front. Cooldown of about 10 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: Corruption in total over 20 seconds to each target

powers.name: Contagion
powers.description: Corruption that spreads by itself. It takes hold of one enemy, then leaps to the nearest other enemy, and again, leaving a little less with each leap. More leaps as it levels. Always available, at a high cost in mana.
powers.potencyNote: Corruption over 20 seconds on the first target, a quarter less with each leap

powers.name: Drain
powers.description: Fastens onto one enemy and drinks. It adds Corruption to them, and for those 20 seconds each tick gives you back a little life. Weak as damage and weak as healing, but cheap for both, and always available.
powers.potencyNote: Corruption in total over 20 seconds; heals you for 5 over the same time

powers.name: Black Sun
powers.description: Ultimate. A black sun opens over a very wide area you choose. Every enemy beneath it is struck at once and left with a heavy load of Corruption, far more than any other power lays down in one cast. Cooldown of about 3 minutes.
powers.potencyNote: damage at once to each target, then 40 Corruption over 20 seconds

powers.name: Umbral Strike
powers.description: A weapon strike wrapped in shadow. The whole hit lands as shadow damage and leaves Corruption on the enemy. Always available.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit, then 4 Corruption over 20 seconds

powers.name: Night Blade
powers.description: A quick, plain weapon strike in shadow, with a small bonus, for almost no mana. No Corruption. The attack to fall back on when mana is short.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit

powers.name: Rupture
powers.description: The payoff for stacking. A weapon strike that deals bonus damage for the Corruption already on the enemy: the more that is ticking on them, the harder this hits. It does not use the Corruption up. Cooldown of about 8 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit, plus half of the Corruption still to tick on the enemy

powers.name: Blind
powers.description: Shadow fills one enemy's eyes. It misses more often for as long as it lives. A modest effect for very little mana. The cooldown, about 6 seconds, is the wait before blinding the next one.
powers.potencyNote: % less chance to hit, until the enemy dies

powers.name: Murk
powers.description: Thick darkness swallows one enemy and those close to it. For about 12 seconds they can barely see to strike and miss most of their attacks. Much stronger than Blind, but it wears off. Cooldown of about 40 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: % less chance to hit for 12 seconds, for each target

powers.name: Night Terrors
powers.description: Torments one enemy for 20 seconds. It adds Corruption to them, and for as long as that Corruption is ticking they flail and miss more often. Keep the Corruption going and the blindness stays. Cooldown of about 10 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: Corruption in total over 20 seconds; 15% less chance to hit while it ticks

powers.name: Wither
powers.description: A wasting curse on one enemy. It adds a little Corruption, and until the enemy dies every tick of damage over time on it, from anyone, hits harder. The power that makes the rest of the essence worth stacking. Cooldown of about 12 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: Corruption in total over 20 seconds; damage over time on the enemy deals 25% more until it dies

powers.name: Soul Rend
powers.description: Tears away one enemy's protection against the astral. Until it dies it has no Astral resistance and no Astral immunity at all. No damage. Far stronger than the aura's curse, on one enemy at a time. Cooldown of about 45 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: % of the enemy's Astral resistance and immunity removed, until it dies

powers.name: Cloak of Night
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself, with two gifts. You wrap yourself in shadow: monsters notice you later and prefer your allies. And the dark turns blows aside: 3 more armor, and 1 more with each level of the power. The stealth never grows; the armor does.
powers.potencyNote: % apparent distance: monsters treat you as half again as far away; also 3 armor, +1 for each level

powers.name: Malice
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. Every tick of damage over time you cause deals a little more. It does nothing for direct hits.
powers.potencyNote: % more damage from your damage over time, lasting

powers.name: Night's Edge
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. Your weapon is edged with shadow: every hit that lands also leaves a trace of Corruption on the enemy, adding to the same Corruption your other powers build.
powers.potencyNote: Corruption added by each weapon hit that lands, lasting

powers.name: Bedrock
powers.description: Aura. You and every ally within its radius take a point less from every physical hit, blows and arrows alike, for as long as they stay near you. Small, but it comes off every single hit.
powers.potencyNote: point off every physical hit, for you and allies in the aura

powers.name: Stone Spike
powers.description: Spikes of rock burst from the ground at a spot you choose, striking every enemy in a small area. Always available.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target

powers.name: Tremor
powers.description: The ground at a spot you choose keeps shaking for about 10 seconds. Every 2 seconds each enemy standing on that small patch is hurt. No hit up front; it pays off when enemies stay on it or are held there. Cooldown of about 10 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: damage in total over 10 seconds to each enemy standing on it

powers.name: Earthquake
powers.description: A wide stretch of ground you choose heaves and cracks for about 20 seconds. Every 2 seconds each enemy on it is hurt. Less per tick than Tremor, over a far larger area and for twice as long. Cooldown of about 45 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: damage in total over 20 seconds to each enemy standing on it

powers.name: Landslide
powers.description: Rock and earth crash down over a wide area you choose. Each enemy takes less than Stone Spike would deal, but far more of them are caught. Costly, and always available.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target

powers.name: Upheaval
powers.description: Ultimate. The earth erupts over a very wide area you choose. Every enemy on it takes heavy damage and is thrown off its feet, unable to move or act for about 4 seconds. Cooldown of about 3 minutes.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target; held for 4 seconds

powers.name: Stone Fist
powers.description: The plain weapon attack. A strike with the weight of stone behind it; the whole hit lands as earth damage, plus a little more. Cheap and always available.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit

powers.name: Boulder
powers.description: Hurls a boulder at one enemy. A projectile: it flies, and like any bolt it can miss. Cheap and always available.
powers.potencyNote: damage

powers.name: Shockwave
powers.description: A weapon strike that sends a shock through the ground, hitting your target and every enemy standing close to it. Each takes less than Stone Fist would deal. Always available.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit to each target

powers.name: Earthshatter
powers.description: A weapon strike that cracks the ground under one enemy. It is hurt and left staggering, unable to move or act, for about 2 seconds. Cooldown of about 10 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit; held for 2 seconds

powers.name: Crushing Blow
powers.description: A heavy, deliberate weapon strike that breaks whatever protects the enemy. It hits hard, and until the enemy dies it takes more damage from every source. One enemy at a time. Cooldown of about 45 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit; the enemy takes 15% more damage until it dies

powers.name: Mire
powers.description: The ground at a spot you choose turns to sucking mud. Every enemy in the small area is stuck fast, unable to move or act, for about 4 seconds. No damage; throw a Tremor under them. Cooldown of about 40 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: seconds held, for each target

powers.name: Stoneskin
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself, with two gifts. Your skin takes on the hardness of stone: your armor is raised, so fewer blows land, and every physical hit that does land is reduced by a couple of points. It adds to the aura.
powers.potencyNote: points off every physical hit you take; also 10 armor, lasting

powers.name: Dig In
powers.description: Plant your feet. For about 20 seconds every physical hit you take is reduced by far more than your lasting boons manage. The button for when you are surrounded. Cooldown of about a minute.
powers.potencyNote: points off every physical hit you take, for 20 seconds

powers.name: Stone Wall
powers.description: For about 15 seconds every ally in the game, wherever they are, takes a few points less from every physical hit. Smaller than Dig In, given to everyone. Cooldown of about a minute.
powers.potencyNote: points off every physical hit, for every ally, for 15 seconds

powers.name: Earthen Might
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. The strength of the mountain is in your arms: your Power is raised.
powers.potencyNote: Power, lasting; +1 for each level

powers.name: Monolith
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself, with two gifts. You stand like a standing stone, impossible to ignore: monsters notice you first and prefer you over your allies. And there is more of you to break: your maximum life is raised. Its threat does not add to Unyielding's.
powers.potencyNote: % apparent distance: monsters treat you as half as far away; also 10% maximum life

powers.name: Unyielding
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself, with three gifts. Blows no longer stagger you: taking a hit never interrupts what you are doing. Every physical hit you take is 1 point lighter, and half a point more with each level of the power. And you will not be moved or ignored: monsters notice you first and prefer you over your allies. The threat never grows, and does not add to Monolith's.
powers.potencyNote: % apparent distance: monsters treat you as half as far away; also hits no longer stagger you, and 1 point off every physical hit, +1 every two levels

powers.name: Lightning
powers.description: A bolt of lightning tears out from you in a straight line, striking everything in its path. (Already in the game: the original Lightning spell.)
powers.potencyNote: damage to everything in its path (the original spell, with the game's own numbers)

powers.name: Chain Lightning
powers.description: Lightning strikes at an enemy and forks to every other enemy in sight. Costly, and devastating in a crowded room. (Already in the game: the original Chain Lightning.)
powers.potencyNote: damage to every enemy in sight (the original spell, with the game's own numbers)

powers.name: Charged Bolt
powers.description: A spray of small bolts skitters out in the direction you face, wandering as they go. Cheap; more bolts as it levels. (Already in the game: the original Charged Bolt.)
powers.potencyNote: damage for each bolt that lands (the original spell, with the game's own numbers)

powers.name: Spark
powers.description: Flicks a small spark of lightning at one enemy. A projectile: it can miss. Weak, but very cheap for what it does; the attack to fall back on when mana is short.
powers.potencyNote: damage

powers.name: Arc
powers.description: The plain chain attack. Lightning strikes one enemy, then leaps to the nearest other enemy, and again, a little weaker with each leap. More leaps as it levels. Always available.
powers.potencyNote: damage to the first target, a quarter less with each leap

powers.name: Forked Lightning
powers.description: Lightning strikes one enemy and forks to the two nearest others, hitting all three at full strength. It never loses power as it spreads, but it never reaches a fourth. Cooldown of about 10 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each of three targets

powers.name: Thunderstrike
powers.description: A single heavy bolt called straight down onto one enemy. It lands at once and cannot miss. The essence's one big hit on a single target. Cooldown of about 8 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: damage

powers.name: Ball Lightning
powers.description: Hurls a crackling ball at one enemy. A projectile: it can miss. Where it hits it bursts, and its lightning leaps on to the nearest other enemies, a little weaker each time. Cooldown of about 30 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: damage on the hit, then a quarter less with each leap

powers.name: Tempest
powers.description: Ultimate. A storm breaks on one enemy and races through the room, leaping from enemy to enemy far more times than any other chain, and losing little as it goes. Cooldown of about 3 minutes.
powers.potencyNote: damage to the first target, a tenth less with each of up to 8 leaps

powers.name: Shocking Grasp
powers.description: The essence's one weapon attack. The whole hit lands as lightning damage, plus a little more, and the shock leaps from your target to the two nearest other enemies. Cooldown of about 8 seconds.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit; 3 lightning to each of the two nearest other enemies

powers.name: Storm's Focus
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. Your Spirit is raised, so every spell you cast hits harder.
powers.potencyNote: Spirit, lasting; +1 for each level

powers.name: Amplify
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. Everything you do deals a little more damage: weapon hits, spells and effects over time alike.
powers.potencyNote: % more damage dealt, lasting

powers.name: Overcharge
powers.description: For about 20 seconds everything you do deals far more damage. The button to press before unloading on a room. Cooldown of about a minute.
powers.potencyNote: % more damage dealt for 20 seconds

powers.name: Quickening
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. You walk faster: each step takes one frame less. It does not change how fast you attack or cast.
powers.potencyNote: frame less for each step you walk (8 frames down to 7, about an eighth faster), lasting

powers.name: Dynamo
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. Your mana comes back faster, to feed a great many spells.
powers.potencyNote: % faster mana regeneration, lasting

powers.name: Teleport
powers.description: You vanish in a crack of lightning and reappear at the spot you choose. No damage. (Already in the game: the original Teleport, now a Lightning power.)
powers.potencyNote: moves you to the spot chosen (the original spell, with the game's own cost)

powers.name: Charged Air
powers.description: Aura. The air around you hums with charge. You and every ally within its radius deal a little more damage with spell attacks for as long as they stay near you. It does nothing for weapon attacks.
powers.potencyNote: % more spell attack damage, for you and allies in the aura (not special attacks)

powers.name: Font of Life
powers.description: Aura. Every ally within its radius, yourself included, has a slightly larger health pool for as long as they stay near you.
powers.potencyNote: % maximum life, lasting, for allies in the aura

powers.name: Vigor
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. Your health pool is larger.
powers.potencyNote: % maximum life, lasting

powers.name: Hearty
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. Your life comes back faster.
powers.potencyNote: % faster life regeneration, lasting

powers.name: Bolster
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. Their health pool is a little larger. Smaller than Vigor, because it can be given away.
powers.potencyNote: % maximum life, lasting

powers.name: Thriving
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. Their life comes back a little faster.
powers.potencyNote: % faster life regeneration, lasting

powers.name: Surge of Life
powers.description: For about 20 seconds every ally in the game has a much larger health pool, and the extra arrives full. The button for the moment before a boss hits hard.
powers.potencyNote: % maximum life for 20 seconds, for every ally

powers.name: Lifeblood
powers.description: For about 20 seconds your own life pours back many times faster than usual. Yours alone.
powers.potencyNote: % faster life regeneration for 20 seconds

powers.name: Lifeline
powers.description: The plain heal. Restores a fair amount of life to one ally, or to yourself, as often as you have mana for it.
powers.potencyNote: healing

powers.name: Flourish
powers.description: A small, cheap heal on one ally. Less life than Lifeline each cast, but more life for the mana.
powers.potencyNote: healing

powers.name: Second Wind
powers.description: A heal on one ally that is stronger the closer they are to death: on someone nearly dead it restores about twice as much. A short cooldown.
powers.potencyNote: healing; twice that on someone under a third of their life

powers.name: Restoration
powers.description: Restores a large share of one ally's whole health pool at once, so the bigger the pool, the bigger the heal. It grows with every boon that enlarges the pool.
powers.potencyNote: % of the ally's maximum life

powers.name: Lifelink
powers.description: A heal that lands on one ally and leaps on to the nearest wounded ally, and again, a little weaker each leap.
powers.potencyNote: healing to the first target, less with each leap

powers.name: Life Burst
powers.description: A burst of life centred on one ally that also heals everyone standing close to them. A short cooldown.
powers.potencyNote: healing to each target

powers.name: Pulse of Life
powers.description: Heals every ally in the game at once, wherever they are. Weaker for each of them than a heal aimed at one.
powers.potencyNote: healing to each ally

powers.name: Regrowth
powers.description: A heal over time on one ally: a steady amount every 2 seconds. More life in total than Lifeline for the same mana, but it takes its time.
powers.potencyNote: healing in total over 8 seconds

powers.name: Invigorate
powers.description: Heals you at once, and for about 20 seconds your health pool is much larger. Two effects in one cast, and yours alone.
powers.potencyNote: healing; also 20 % maximum life for 20 seconds

powers.name: Breath of Life
powers.description: Brings one fallen ally back to life with most of their life restored, more than any other essence's resurrection gives.
powers.potencyNote: % of their life on rising

powers.name: Genesis
powers.description: The Life ultimate, three effects in one cast. Every ally in the game is healed for a great deal, the fallen among them rise, and for about 30 seconds everyone's health pool is much larger.
powers.potencyNote: % of life for the risen; the living are healed 30; everyone +20% maximum life for 30 seconds

powers.name: Siphon Life
powers.description: Draws the life out of one enemy: it takes Life damage, and part of what it loses comes back to you as healing. Life's everyday attack.
powers.potencyNote: damage; heals you 4

powers.name: Vital Surge
powers.description: A burst of raw life on the spot you choose. Monsters caught in it take Life damage; allies caught in it are healed. A short cooldown.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target; heals 8

powers.name: Leyline
powers.description: Aura. Every ally within its radius, yourself included, has a slightly larger mana pool for as long as they stay near you.
powers.potencyNote: % maximum mana, lasting, for allies in the aura

powers.name: Arcane Mind
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. Your Spirit is raised by a few points, and by one more with each level of the power.
powers.potencyNote: Spirit, lasting; +1 for each level

powers.name: Spellcraft
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. Your spell attacks deal more damage.
powers.potencyNote: % more spell attack damage, lasting

powers.name: Deep Well
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. Your mana pool is larger.
powers.potencyNote: % maximum mana, lasting

powers.name: Meditation
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. Your mana comes back faster.
powers.potencyNote: % faster mana regeneration, lasting

powers.name: Insight
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. Their Spirit is raised by a point, and by one more with each level of the power. Smaller than Arcane Mind, because it can be given away.
powers.potencyNote: Spirit, lasting; +1 for each level

powers.name: Empower
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. Their spell attacks deal a little more damage.
powers.potencyNote: % more spell attack damage, lasting

powers.name: Attunement
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. Their mana comes back a little faster.
powers.potencyNote: % faster mana regeneration, lasting

powers.name: Expanded Mind
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. Their mana pool is a little larger.
powers.potencyNote: % maximum mana, lasting

powers.name: Arcane Surge
powers.description: For about 20 seconds your spell attacks deal much more damage. Yours alone.
powers.potencyNote: % more spell attack damage for 20 seconds

powers.name: Mana Font
powers.description: Gives a helping of mana to every ally in the game at once, wherever they are. It costs you more than any one of them receives.
powers.potencyNote: mana given to every ally

powers.name: Ascendance
powers.description: The Magic ultimate, three effects in one cast, and yours alone. For about 30 seconds your spell attacks deal far more damage, your mana pours back, and your mana pool is much larger.
powers.potencyNote: % more spell attack damage for 30 seconds; also 30 % faster mana regeneration and 30 % maximum mana

powers.name: Expose
powers.description: A lasting affliction on one enemy. All three of its resistances are lowered a little until it dies. Does nothing about immunity.
powers.potencyNote: points off all three resistances, until it dies

powers.name: Unravel
powers.description: A lasting affliction on one enemy and everything close to it. All three of their resistances are lowered a great deal until they die. Does nothing about immunity.
powers.potencyNote: points off all three resistances, until they die

powers.name: Magic Missile
powers.description: A bolt of raw magic at one enemy. Magic's everyday attack.
powers.potencyNote: damage

powers.name: Arcane Burst
powers.description: A burst of Arcane damage on the spot you choose, hitting everything close to it.
powers.potencyNote: damage to each target

powers.name: Disintegrate
powers.description: A very heavy hit on one enemy for a great deal of mana. Far more damage than Magic Missile each cast, far less for the mana.
powers.potencyNote: damage

powers.name: Arcane Barrage
powers.description: Arcane damage that strikes one enemy and leaps on to the nearest other enemy, and again, a little weaker each leap. A short cooldown.
powers.potencyNote: damage to the first target, a quarter less each leap

powers.name: Arcane Lance
powers.description: A heavy hit on one enemy that also leaves it open: all three of its resistances are lowered until it dies. Two effects in one cast.
powers.potencyNote: damage; also 15 points off all three resistances

powers.name: Battle Standard
powers.description: Aura. Every ally within its radius, yourself included, deals slightly more damage with special attacks for as long as they stay near you.
powers.potencyNote: % more special attack damage, for you and allies in the aura

powers.name: Brawn
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. Your Power is raised by a few points, and by one more with each level of the power.
powers.potencyNote: Power, lasting; +1 for each level

powers.name: Weapon Mastery
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. Your special attacks deal more damage.
powers.potencyNote: % more special attack damage, lasting

powers.name: Keen Eye
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. Your weapon attacks land more often.
powers.potencyNote: % better chance to hit with weapon attacks, lasting

powers.name: Thick Hide
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself. Your armor is raised.
powers.potencyNote: armor, lasting

powers.name: Unbowed
powers.description: A lasting boon on yourself, with two gifts. Your health pool is larger, and hits no longer stagger you: nothing interrupts your swing.
powers.potencyNote: % maximum life, lasting; also hits no longer stagger you

powers.name: Embolden
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. Their Power is raised by a point, and by one more with each level of the power. Smaller than Brawn, because it can be given away.
powers.potencyNote: Power, lasting; +1 for each level

powers.name: Sharpen
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. Their special attacks deal a little more damage.
powers.potencyNote: % more special attack damage, lasting

powers.name: Guiding Hand
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. Their weapon attacks land a little more often.
powers.potencyNote: % better chance to hit with weapon attacks, lasting

powers.name: Fortify
powers.description: A lasting boon on one ally. Their armor is raised a little, and by a point more with each level of the power.
powers.potencyNote: armor, lasting; +1 for each level

powers.name: Battle Fury
powers.description: For about 20 seconds your special attacks deal much more damage. Yours alone.
powers.potencyNote: % more special attack damage for 20 seconds

powers.name: Rallying Cry
powers.description: For about 20 seconds every ally in the game has more armor and lands their weapon attacks more often. Two effects in one cast.
powers.potencyNote: armor for every ally for 20 seconds; also 15 % better chance to hit

powers.name: Juggernaut
powers.description: The Might ultimate, three effects in one cast, and yours alone. For about 30 seconds your special attacks deal far more damage, your health pool is much larger, and your armor is far higher.
powers.potencyNote: % more special attack damage for 30 seconds; also 30 % maximum life and 30 armor

powers.name: Heavy Blow
powers.description: A weapon strike with extra damage. Might's everyday attack.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit

powers.name: Sweeping Strike
powers.description: A weapon strike that carries the same hit to every other enemy close to the target.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit to each target

powers.name: Precise Strike
powers.description: A weapon strike that cannot miss. Little extra damage, but it always lands.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit; cannot miss

powers.name: Mighty Blow
powers.description: A weapon strike with a great deal of extra damage. A short cooldown.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit

powers.name: Staggering Blow
powers.description: A weapon strike that leaves the enemy reeling: it misses more often until it dies. A short cooldown.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit; the enemy has 20% less chance to hit until it dies

powers.name: Sunder
powers.description: A weapon strike that breaks the enemy's guard: it takes more damage from everything until it dies. A long cooldown, for the monster that matters.
powers.potencyNote: bonus damage on the hit; the enemy takes 15% more damage until it dies

powers.name: Intimidate
powers.description: A lasting affliction on one enemy and everything close to it. They all miss more often until they die.
powers.potencyNote: % less chance to hit, for each target, until it dies
